question: What universal range must be encompassed when meditating on that reality in every place?
premises: Meditation is performed in place after place.
The object of meditation extends from Shiva down to Avici.
inference: One should meditate on that reality in every place as pervading all levels from Shiva to Avici.
plain_english: Having meditated on that in place after place, as extending from Shiva down to Avici.
